element: A bounded protocol-related resource / object pool with a fixed upper limit (e.g., sessions)
dangerous_operation: Allocating the resource on a resource-creating request, and the handling path taken when the limit is reached (e.g., fatal error on count >= MAX, or dereferencing a failed allocation)
missing_validation: Availability/capacity handling that treats resource exhaustion as a normal error case (reject with an appropriate error cause) instead of crashing
security_impact: Crash when the resource pool is exhausted by resource-creating requests -> DoS or other security impact
pattern_description: The component enforces fixed upper bounds on protocol-related resources (e.g., sessions), but the message handling path does not correctly treat resource exhaustion as a normal error case. Instead of rejecting the request with an appropriate error cause, the implementation crashes when a resource limit is hit (e.g., fatal error on count >= MAX, dereferencing a failed allocation). An attacker can exhaust these object pools by sending resource-creating protocol requests, leading to DoS or other security impact.
